title: PhishVN Edge: ONNX export, edge CPU benchmarking, and TensorRT inference for Vietnamese phishing URL detection
description: Standalone tools for exporting scikit-learn URL detectors to ONNX, benchmarking batch-one inference on Linux edge devices with ONNX Runtime, and building and validating a TensorRT FP32 engine on NVIDIA Jetson. Ships the exported 21-feature PhishVN HistGB detector with a model card and SHA-256 manifest, an offline URL feature extractor, and the aggregate snapshots behind the reported figures. Raw training and test records, fitted research models, and device-specific TensorRT engines are not included.
